fields.label: Protected
fields.description: A reallocation moving money into or out of this category needs a second approval, and that approval cannot come from the requester or from the project manager who approved it. General Conditions, Contingency and Fee are protected: the first is where an overrun gets absorbed quietly, and the last is where contracted work becomes margin.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Hidden from new budget lines. Existing lines keep their category, so disabling one never rewrites a budget that was already agreed.

fields.options: These declare which instrument could record spend against this category, and they are read as a statement of what this site can observe today rather than as an aspiration. A category whose source holds no rows anywhere reports its spend as Not Tracked instead of 0.00 — a zero that means nobody records this must never be read as nothing was spent. A category with no source at all reports No Source, which is correct for Contingency and Fee: money leaves those by reallocation, never by purchase.
